detail.title: Advancing Endocrine-Neurological Research
detail.summary: Advancing the 'Hormonal Regulation of Nervous System Function' project by initiating a targeted search for clinical literature, as the current project evidence is limited to bibliographic metadata.

children.title: neurological symptoms and manifestations of thyroid and adrenal dysfunction integrative review

detail.reason: The existing evidence for this project is bibliographic and provides no clinical or mechanistic detail; this search targets integrative medical reviews to address the project's question.
